reasoning_question: 如果observability-charts的仓库地址或索引内容发生变化，哪些HelmRelease需要重新协调？请给出包含Kustomization依赖的整体协调顺序，并说明grafana与loki之间的关系。
flux_manifests:
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: app-config
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 2m
  url: https://git.repo.internal/team/app-config.git
  ref:
    branch: staging
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: base
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./clusters/staging/base
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: app-config
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: observability
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./clusters/staging/observability
  prune: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: base
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: app-config
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: HelmRepository
metadata:
  name: observability-charts
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  url: https://charts.repo.internal/observability
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: loki
  namespace: observability
spec:
  interval: 10m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: loki
      version: 6.15.0
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: observability-charts
        namespace: flux-system
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: grafana
  namespace: observability
spec:
  interval: 10m
  dependsOn:
    - name: loki
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: grafana
      version: 8.5.0
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: observability-charts
        namespace: flux-system
reasoning_answer: 一种有效的协调顺序是app-config、base、observability、observability-charts、loki、grafana。app-config先为两个Kustomization提供源工件，observability必须等待base完成。observability-charts与GitRepository分支相互独立；其变化会触发loki重新协调，grafana既依赖同一HelmRepository，又通过dependsOn等待loki达到就绪状态，因此grafana位于loki之后。

config_change_propagation.change_explanation: HelmRepository负责提供Loki和Grafana所需的Chart索引及包内容。仓库地址或索引变化会使直接引用它的loki重新解析Chart并协调；grafana虽然也直接引用该HelmRepository，但还声明dependsOn依赖loki，因此其协调顺序位于loki之后。app-config及其base、observability分支不引用该HelmRepository，不会因该仓库变化而产生直接传播。
